title: Agent on Browser project config (.cockpit/config.json)
description: Its presence turns the cockpit on for a project; without it the hooks stay silent. Every key is optional. Paths are relative to the project root. This lists exactly what src/build/config.mjs reads; docs/design-config.schema.json is the fuller design it grows towards.

title.description: The board's title, and the name the hooks use for the project.

local.description: Runtime state: activity feed, event log, snapshot, publish receipt, per-session files. Gitignored; it holds your prompts.

artifact.description: The published board's claude.ai link. Empty until the first publish; Claude fills it in.

harness.description: Which adapter speaks to the agent (src/adapters/).

plan.description: draft = the owner has not accepted the plan yet: no card can start or close. init and the plan command set draft; Accept plan on the board sets accepted.

finish.description: The card whose dependency tree is the finish path, e.g. "1.5". null = no finish path.

wip.description: Cards each owner can run at once.

auto.description: Automatic work (docs/16-live-feed-contract.md, section 5). A value of the wrong type or out of range falls back to its default and `cockpit status` says so. Only `paused` can be changed from the board.

start.description: The agent may start the next ready agent card that needs no approval (`cockpit next --start`). init writes false: controlled first.

inARow.description: Automatic starts allowed since the owner's last action.

perDay.description: Automatic starts allowed in any 24 hours.

pauseOnQuestion.description: No automatic start while a question to the owner is unanswered.

paused.description: The owner's switch: Pause automatic work.

installed.description: The owner has turned the session timer on (in an open Claude Code session: /loop 30m /browser-agent heartbeat). Set by hand; nothing writes it, and it starts nothing.

decisionGoals.description: Overrides the record's Goal column for decision rows, e.g. { "D1": 2 }.

watchGoals.description: Overrides the record's Goal column for watch rows.

phaseEnd.description: Overrides a phase's "Ends with:" line from the record.

tile.description: An optional sixth tile: a number read from the record's "Where this stands" row named `row`.

hooks.description: Paths the Stop hook never counts as unaccounted work.
